Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks

pancake noun

also pancakes, batter

modern

M-O s.v. pancake

laganum, laganī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

Classically a flour-and-oil cake (Hor. S. 1.6.115).

Other words

  • 1artolaganus: masculine (Traupman 72, 356 artolaganum, neuter). Lewis & Short has only the masculine (Cic. Fam. 9.20.1).

    artolaganus1, artolaganī m. — a bread-cake

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 9.20.1; Traupman 356 · Declension on Wiktionary

    Traupman 72 and 356 uses it for “pancake”.

  • laganum Americānum (crassum) — thick pancake

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. pancake

Examples

  • Hodiē lagana coquēmus.

    Today we’re making pancakes.composed

  • Mel laganō tuō īnfundam?

    Shall I pour honey on your pancake?composed

See also crêpe, waffle, omelette.

SourcesLewis & Short: artolaganus · Lewis & Short: laganum

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. pancake.

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 72, 356.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
